text:
alex: deploy-bot flagged a canary failure in us-east-1 for payments-service — values checksum drift detected on configmap 'payments-values', rollout paused.
maria: I see the failed pods show 503s during startup, looks like an env var mismatch from the new overlay.
deploy-bot: Canary health: 3/8 failed (startup 503), reason: mismatched SECRET_REF in values. Logs: `failed to resolve secret payments-db-cred`
jen: Can we hotpatch the values for the canary subset only and re-trigger? We might avoid full rollback if it's just a missing secret ref.
kevin: We patched the secret last night but only in eu-west env. Apparently the us-east overlay didn't get the same KMS rotation.
release-manager: We have a change window ending in ~45m. Options: 1) Rollback to previous chart (immediate), 2) Patch values and re-run canary (fast but riskier), 3) Pin the release & schedule manual follow-up after window. Thoughts?
alex: Prefer patch and re-run canary if it's just secret mapping — quicker. But we need clear rollback criteria in case health doesn't improve within 5m.
maria: Agreed. I'll prepare a scoped values patch. Patch will only update `secrets.payments_db.ref` to the old ref used in prev release.
jen: Paste the helm command here when ready. I'll run the canary reapply and watch logs.
maria: Command: ```helm upgrade --install payments-service ./charts/payments -f values/production.yaml -f values/overlays/us-east-canary.yaml --set-file secrets.payments_db.ref=<(echo "old-ref") --wait --timeout 3m```
kevin: After patch, deploy-bot should re-evaluate; set deploy-bot policy to auto-skip further regions until canary passes.
deploy-bot: Reapply queued. Canary re-triggered at 4067890200. Will post health update.
deploy-bot: Canary health: 7/8 OK after patch, 1 pod still restarting but passing readiness. Monitoring for 10m.
release-manager: Good. Assemble release notes: call out hotpatch to secret ref, note that we didn't change chart version. I'll add an entry under "post-release fixes" and notify security for the KMS rotation gap.
alex: Also file a follow-up to reconcile overlay sync — assign to infra-team.
jen: :thumbsup: If anything degrades, we roll back immediately to v1.14.2 (previous chart).
kevin: I'll coordinate a small blameless postmortem and checklist to prevent overlay drift across regions.
maria: Patch promoted to stable at 4067890425. Closing this hold.
release-manager: Noted — releasing post-release note draft now. Will ping #announcements after approvals. :eyes:
